summary: PaiCoach combines AI-generated feedback with human review to support parent-led communication interventions. A four-family single-case study found improvements in parent implementation and child responsiveness, while showing the continued need for expert oversight.
imageAlt: PaiCoach interaction workflow from login and video upload through AI analysis, human review, parent feedback, and chatbot support.

summary: An LLM-powered humanoid robot combines speech, vision, and gesture during shared reading about AI. Comparing three dialogue policies on real hardware identifies how structured interaction and bounded language-model support can improve pedagogical coherence.
imageAlt: Four-stage robot-assisted reading workflow, from identifying an apple in a story to checking real objects and correcting the robot, alongside the humanoid robot.

summary: SciEval benchmarks how well language models evaluate K-12 science instructional materials against an educator-designed rubric. It contains 273 lessons annotated across 13 criteria, with scores and supporting rationales, and tests whether domain-specific fine-tuning improves evaluation.
imageAlt: Diagram linking the EQuIP rubric's three categories to corresponding elements of a science lesson, including learning activities, instructional support, and assessment.

summary: LLM4Art uses expert-informed prompts and rubrics to examine visual analysis, historical context, and cultural significance. A 50-artwork benchmark compares five language models, and a web application makes the interpretation workflow available to users.
imageAlt: LLM4Art application showing an uploaded painting, artwork metadata, and interpretation panels for visual analysis, historical context, and cultural significance.

summary: Two science education experts review evaluations from GPT, Claude, and Gemini across 12 curriculum units. The study distinguishes agreement on numerical scores from agreement on reasoning and suggestions, revealing where model judgments depart from educational expertise.
imageAlt: Six grouped bar charts compare two experts' agreement with LLM scores, reasoning, and suggestions across science topics and model families.

summary: StoryLab helps K-2 teachers create personalized stories with illustrations, narration, and vocabulary support. Teachers specify learning goals and review generated materials, connecting children's interests with classroom literacy objectives.
imageAlt: StoryLab teacher dashboard with a student profile, reading-skill charts, story library, generation controls, and a generated story review panel.

summary: ASD-HI provides a multimodal benchmark for detecting parents' communication strategies and assessing implementation fidelity during home interventions. A baseline pipeline combines speech recognition, video analysis, and language-model prompting to support automated assessment.
imageAlt: ASD-HI pipeline sends interaction videos through speech recognition and frame analysis, then identifies strategy segments and fidelity scores using language models.

summary: Storio pairs an interactive e-book with Mia, a bilingual conversational reading partner. A design-probe study with 17 children, plus parents and educators, examines adaptive feedback and identifies design considerations for children learning English as a foreign language.
imageAlt: Storio interaction diagram connects children's spoken responses, speech recognition, expert-written examples, GPT-4 feedback, and narrated bilingual story reading.

summary: A randomized trial with 67 children compares AI-guided and parent-led e-book reading. Children in the AI-guided group showed stronger reading comprehension, while vocabulary and story-retelling benefits were comparable; the study also examines differences in engagement.
imageAlt: Storio reading interface and dialogue flow show story questions, bilingual child input, and different scaffolding paths for correct and incorrect answers.

summary: This study tests how the number and quality of prompt examples affect LLM assessment of science essays. Three-example GPT-4o prompts outperformed customized baseline tools for identifying rubric-based main ideas, underscoring the importance of demonstration design.
imageAlt: A science essay about roller-coaster energy is color-coded beside an automated feedback checklist identifying present and missing scientific ideas.
